title: dayia glutinosa
intro: Dayia glutinosa, commonly known as Daybreak or Desert Dayflower, is a small, perennial plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The health benefits of Dayia glutinosa include its potential to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, such as skin infections, wounds, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Dayia glutinosa include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
